annotations.title: Build an issue from a layout

description: Build a new issue (Ausgabe) from a layout description (issue plan) and a template – an open document (template_document_id) or the .idml/.indd of the previous issue (template_path). The template supplies styles, swatches, parent pages, layers and page settings. Each spread of the plan is either {from_template: "<page name>"} (taken over with its content) or new: pages from a template spread with the same number of pages (page_template, template_spreads {"<page count>": "<page name>"} or the spread at the same position), parent pages by prefix, objects as in the layout. Frames of one story are threaded across spreads (chain_index, otherwise plan order). Images and ad PDFs are linked; fit fill|proportional|trim_box fits them from the file (trim_box: the TrimBox of the PDF at trim_box_at_mm, scale 1 unless given). The result is written as IDML (idml_path or the temporary folder) and opened in InDesign; an opened IDML is an untitled document, so pass save_path (.indd) to save it under that name. Returns document_id, idml_path, saved_to, pages, spreads, new_spreads, template_spreads, objects, overset_count and overset_stories, missing_links, missing_fonts and durations_ms (template, build, open, save, check).

idml_path.description: Where to write the built .idml. Default: the temporary folder.

layout.description: Layout description as JSON: {spreads: [{parents: [prefix per page], objects: [...]}, or {from_template: "<page name>"}], stories: {key: [{style, runs: [{text, character_style, local}], local}]}}; a single spread may also be given as {pages, objects, stories}. Objects: {type text|image|pdf|rectangle|placeholder|raw, page (0-based within the spread), x, y, width, height in mm from the top left corner of that page, rotation 0|90|270, story (text), file plus fit fill|proportional|trim_box or scale, offset_mm, graphic_bounds_pt (image, pdf), fill, tint, stroke, stroke_weight_pt, object_style, layer, text_wrap, frame_options (IDML TextFramePreference attributes such as TextColumnCount, TextColumnGutter in pt), inset_pt, chain_index}. Styles and swatches are referenced by name (ParagraphStyle reference as in IDML, e.g. "Group%3aName" for a style in a group). Measures are used unrounded. read_layout returns this format; the German keys of earlier layout files (seiten, objekte, boegen, typ, b, h …) are accepted too.

layout_path.description: Path of a .json file with the layout description, instead of layout.

open.description: Open the result in InDesign. Default true. With false only the IDML is written.

overwrite.description: Replace an existing file at save_path. Default false.

save_path.description: Save the opened result as this .indd.

show_window.description: Show the document window. Default true.

template_document_id.description: Open document to use as template (from list_documents).

template_path.description: .idml, .indd or .indt of the previous issue to use as template.
